lesson.grammar_point: to be and present simple in the first person (I am / I live / I play)

listenings.text: Hi. My name is Tyler. I am sixteen years old. I live in Los Angeles, in California. I am a student. I go to Lincoln High School. I play basketball every day after school. My favorite game is NBA Two K. I have two brothers and one sister. I speak English and a little Spanish. Nice to meet you.

Good morning, everybody, and welcome to the summer basketball camp. My name is Coach Ashley. The camp is open from Monday to Friday. We start at nine in the morning and we finish at four in the afternoon. Please bring water, a towel and good shoes. Group one is on court A. Group two is on court B. Now, please tell me your name and your city. Welcome to Los Angeles.

extra_audio.text: Bruno arrives at the basketball court in Los Angeles. He says hello to a girl on the court. He says his name and his age. He says his city and his school. He asks her name too.
